variants.label: european
variants.description: Equivalent to europeancurrents, europeanvoltages, europeanresistors, europeaninductors, europeanports, europeangfsurgearrester.

variants.label: american
variants.description: Equivalent to americancurrents, americanvoltages, americanresistors, americaninductors, americanports, americangfsurgearrester.

variants.label: siunitx
variants.description: Integrates with siunitx. Labels, currents or voltages of the form #1<#2> are rendered as \SI{#1}{#2}.

variants.label: nosiunitx
variants.description: Labels are not interpreted through siunitx integration.

variants.label: europeanvoltages
variants.description: Uses arrows to define voltages, and uses european-style voltage sources.

variants.label: straightvoltages
variants.description: Uses arrows to define voltages, and uses straight voltage arrows.

variants.label: americanvoltages
variants.description: Uses − and + to define voltages, and uses american-style voltage sources.

variants.label: europeancurrents
variants.description: Uses european-style current sources.

variants.label: americancurrents
variants.description: Uses american-style current sources.

variants.label: europeanresistors
variants.description: Uses rectangular empty shape for resistors, as per european standards.

variants.label: americanresistors
variants.description: Uses zig-zag shape for resistors, as per american standards.

variants.label: europeaninductors
variants.description: Uses rectangular filled shape for inductors, as per european standards.

variants.label: americaninductors
variants.description: Uses "4-bumps" shape for inductors, as per american standards.

variants.label: cuteinductors
variants.description: Uses the "pig-tailed" inductor style.

variants.label: europeanports
variants.description: Uses rectangular logic ports, as per european standards.

variants.label: americanports
variants.description: Uses triangular logic ports, as per american standards.

variants.label: americangfsurgearrester
variants.description: Uses round gas filled surge arresters, as per american standards.

variants.label: europeangfsurgearrester
variants.description: Uses rectangular gas filled surge arresters, as per european standards.

variants.label: fulldiode
variants.description: Diodes are drawn and filled by default.

variants.label: strokediode
variants.description: Diodes are drawn and stroked by default.

variants.label: emptydiode
variants.description: Diodes are drawn but not filled by default.

variants.label: arrowmos
variants.description: PMOS and NMOS have arrows analogous to PNP and NPN transistors.

variants.label: noarrowmos
variants.description: PMOS and NMOS do not have arrows analogous to PNP and NPN transistors.

variants.label: fetbodydiode
variants.description: Draw the body diode of a FET.

variants.label: nofetbodydiode
variants.description: Do not draw the body diode of a FET.

variants.label: fetsolderdot
variants.description: Draw solder dot at bulk-source junction of some transistors.

variants.label: nofetsolderdot
variants.description: Do not draw solder dot at bulk-source junction of some transistors.

variants.label: legacytransistorstext
variants.description: Text of transistor nodes is typeset near the collector.

variants.label: centertransistorstext
variants.description: Text of transistor nodes is typeset near the center of the component.

variants.label: straightlabels
variants.description: Labels on bipoles are always printed straight up, with horizontal baseline.

variants.label: rotatelabels
variants.description: Labels on bipoles are always printed aligned along the bipole.

variants.label: smartlabels
variants.description: Labels are rotated along the bipole, unless the rotation is very close to multiples of 90°.

variants.label: compatibility
variants.description: Makes it possible to load CircuiTikZ and TikZ circuit library together.

variants.label: emptypmoscircle
variants.description: The circle at the gate of a PMOS transistor does not get filled.

variants.label: lazymos
variants.description: Draws lazy NMOS and PMOS transistors.

variants.label: arrows.meta
variants.description: Extended arrow tip library (recommended).

variants.label: arrows
variants.description: Legacy arrow tip library.

variants.label: calc
variants.description: Coordinate calculations with the ($...$) notation.

variants.label: patterns
variants.description: Fill patterns for paths and shapes.

variants.label: positioning
variants.description: Place nodes relative to each other with above of, right of, etc.

variants.label: shapes
variants.description: General shape library (includes geometric and misc).

variants.label: shapes.geometric
variants.description: Geometric shapes: ellipse, diamond, trapezium, etc.

variants.label: shapes.misc
variants.description: Miscellaneous shapes: cross out, strike out, etc.

variants.label: mode=text
variants.description: Typeset numbers and units in text mode.

variants.label: mode=math
variants.description: Typeset numbers and units in math mode.

variants.label: per-mode=fraction
variants.description: Display per-unit as a fraction.

variants.label: per-mode=symbol
variants.description: Display per-unit using a symbol (e.g. /).

variants.label: per-mode=repeated-symbol
variants.description: Repeat the unit symbol for per-unit.

commonComponentOptions.label: rotate
commonComponentOptions.description: Rotate the component by angle in degrees.

commonComponentOptions.label: transform shape
commonComponentOptions.description: Apply transformations to the shape itself.
